headline: OpenAI's GPT-5.6 models Sol, Terra, and Luna become generally available on Amazon Bedrock, enhancing AI capabilities with high-performance and reliability.

items.title: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol, Terra, and Luna are now generally available on Amazon Bedrock
items.summary: OpenAI's latest models, GPT-5.6 Sol, Terra, and Luna, are now available on Amazon Bedrock. These models are integrated into Amazon's next-generation inference engine, designed for high performance, security, and reliability. This release signifies a major step in making advanced AI models more accessible to developers, providing enhanced capabilities for various applications. The models are optimized for a seamless experience in AWS environments, offering improved inference times and robust security features.
items.why_it_matters: Tech leads can leverage these powerful models for building more sophisticated AI tools with enhanced performance and security.

items.title: Launching UI for generative AI inference recommendations in Amazon SageMaker AI
items.summary: Amazon SageMaker AI Studio introduced a new UI for optimized generative AI inference recommendations. This low-code no-code experience allows developers to easily access inference recommendations, which previously required a deep understanding of API parameters and raw benchmark data. The UI simplifies the deployment and tuning of generative models, making it more accessible to non-expert users.

items.title: Interpreting Latent CoT Reasoning as Dynamical Systems
items.summary: This research investigates latent reasoning methods such as CODI and COCONUT, which face interpretability challenges. The study introduces a dynamical systems approach to better understand these methods, which maintain multiple candidate traces in the hidden space at each step. This approach aims to improve transparency and interpretability in complex reasoning models.

all_items.title: Building an agentic AI solution at Bluesight with Amazon Bedrock
all_items.summary: In this post, we describe how Bluesight used two AWS engagements and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore to evolve from a single-product AI prototype to Prism, a unified agentic AI solution spanning six healthcare compliance products. Prism Assistant for ControlCheck launched in May 2026 and is already in use by 20 health systems. A more complex multi-product agentic solution is on track for later in 2026.

all_items.title: Implement on-behalf-of token exchange for multi-tenant agents with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway
all_items.summary: Building multi-tenant agents with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore and Apply fine-grained access control with Bedrock AgentCore Gateway interceptors establish the conceptual foundation for on-behalf-of (OBO) token exchange in agentic systems. This post is the implementation guide. It walks through a complete multi-tenant OBO setup against Okta, shows the JSON Web Token (JWT) claim transformations on each hop, and demonstrates how audience binding produces defense in depth that scales across tenants.
